result.title: GPA-VGGT: Geometry-Preserving Acceleration of VGGT
result.comment: Accepted to WACV 2027. Project page: https://noheat61.github.io/GPA-VGGT/
result.summary: Feed-forward geometry models such as VGGT recover camera parameters, depth maps, and point maps from one to hundreds of views in a single forward pass, making them powerful backbones for multi-view 3D perception. However, VGGT's global attention is quadratic in the number of frames and dominates end-to-end runtime on long sequences, which has motivated a range of training-free efficiency methods such as token merging. These methods, however, come with a drop in accuracy that makes them hard to use in place of VGGT. We propose GPA-VGGT, a training-free acceleration method that replaces global attention in early blocks with frame attention augmented by a shared cross-frame K/V set. In the remaining blocks, we merge only keys and values while preserving all queries, restore the attention mass of the tokens each merged key represents, and randomly project the matching metric to 128 dimensions to reduce matching cost. Across diverse multi-view geometry tasks, GPA-VGGT provides training-free acceleration at speedups comparable to prior work while preserving the information required for precise geometric estimation, retaining over 99% of VGGT's pose accuracy under AUC@3.

AI.brief_summary: 提出免训练的 GPA-VGGT，用帧内注意力加共享跨帧 K/V 替换早期块的全局注意力，并在后续块只合并 K/V、保留全部 query 且补偿注意力质量，以加速 VGGT 的多视图几何推理。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「保留 query、合并 K/V 并补偿注意力质量」的视觉 token 压缩策略，可供核查 latent 状态中视觉证据压缩是否会造成几何细节坍缩，并与注意力结构对 latent 相似度的影响相关。
